value.rationale: Gonality and minimal-pencil uniqueness are intrinsic birational invariants with direct geometric meaning. The theorem gives sharp values for all odd prime powers in a natural maximal-curve subfamily, separates exceptional low cases, and proves a high-genus uniqueness threshold. Neither a routine restatement of the original curve nor a mere finite numerical check.
